name: Rajesh Kumar
bio:
Rajesh Kumar's journey into the high-octane world of Formula 1 began unexpectedly. While working in a Michelin-starred restaurant in Mumbai, he catered a private event for a visiting motorsport executive. Impressed by Rajesh's culinary skills and meticulous attention to detail, the executive offered him a position managing catering for a junior racing team. Rajesh quickly adapted, learning the unique demands of feeding a team on the move, from ensuring optimal nutrition for peak performance to accommodating diverse dietary needs. 

Now at Alpine F1, Rajesh oversees all aspects of team catering, from trackside meals to hospitality events. He prides himself on creating menus that are both delicious and nutritious, incorporating fresh, locally sourced ingredients whenever possible. His ability to remain calm under pressure, coupled with his innate understanding of flavor profiles, makes him an invaluable asset to the team. What sets Rajesh apart is his innovative approach to fusion cuisine, subtly blending Indian spices with international dishes to create memorable culinary experiences for the team and guests alike.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Rajesh is of average height, with a warm smile and a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Insists on using only organic spices, even for team meals.
Always carries a small notebook filled with recipe ideas.
Secretly practices yoga in the catering truck before the morning rush.
